description: An employer's gender pay gap reports, read and benchmarked. Median and mean gaps, bonus gaps, women by pay quarter, year-on-year trend and rank against all reporters and the sector. 1 credit. Only employers with 250 or more staff must report, so a smaller one usually has none; public_record carries a summary of the same.

company.description: A UK company number (such as 00502851) is surest; an employer's name also works and the reply names the employer it matched.

name: gender_pay_gap
title: Gender Pay Gap Report Card
